imageWordingNotes: COAST and ROSES headline wording includes 客观; use the detailed OBJECTIVE item as purpose or objective, not a new concept.
CRISPE detail writes STATMENT; record this spelling but normalize its explanatory term as Statement, without introducing a new runtime framework or field.
Role, Example and Experiment are source elements, not mandatory additions to every user task. Existing example permission and strict output rules remain authoritative.
The plain Markdown CT=Context+task is a basic organizing principle, not a thirteenth panel in the twelve-framework image.

plannedRuntimeScope.presentation: Natural mode is coherent and compact; structured mode groups useful responsibilities. Internal four-element validation is not a forced natural paragraph order.
